data.rehearsal_definition: original per-loop chain supervision sampled independently of the 70 percent control-target stream
data.target_rule: continue before exact row depth; stop at exact row depth

descoped_lineage.reason: T1-lite qualifies the actuator for D0, whose substrate trains the full recurrent block

do_not_claim: token-pathway success if any gate fails
that the EMA implementation was mathematically wrong
which seed-0 curriculum stage first produced EMA lag
any result from a passive EMA shadow as a registered endpoint

causal_override.continue_override: force continue at required depth and execute depth plus one
causal_override.stop_override: force stop at every k from 1 through row depth

chain_accuracy.rule: forced-depth chain accuracy within three points of lineage reference

control_selection.rule: selected stop loop equals stated required depth

self_halted_accuracy.rule: self-halted accuracy within three points of paired forced depth

pilot_p0.transfer_rule: the selected lambda and ratio may be locked for T1-lite, but the full-block run must independently clear all four gates
